live_sources_not_bundled: FIRMS (CC0), USGS (public domain), Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0), NDBC (public domain) are fetched at runtime by whichever side draws them and are not mounted as files. OpenSky is non-commercial research; a bridge-side reading of it inherits that.
